peopleTypesIntro.message: Roles shown when someone participates in an app (for example Lead and Contact in Sales, or Customer and Agent in Helpdesk). Changes apply everywhere those dropdowns are used—no page reload needed.

peopleTypesHintMinOne.message: At least one role is required per app. Names cannot duplicate (ignoring case).

peopleTypesHintDefaultRole.message: The default role is used in quick create and attach when no type is pre-selected.

peopleTypesHintColors.message: Colors work like picklist options: use the swatch or hex field, and the preview pill matches what people see in lists.

peopleTypesHintParticipation.message: Optionally choose which participation fields appear in quick create and attach when a type is selected. Leaving a type on platform defaults does not store anything—if defaults change later, this type picks them up. Unchecking every field stores no fields for that type (explicit).

peopleTypesEmptyRoles.message: No roles defined. Click "Add Option" to add values.

peopleTypesInUse.message: In use by {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}

peopleTypesFieldsWhenSelected.message: Fields when this type is selected

peopleTypesResetPlatformDefaults.description: Reset type fields to platform defaults

peopleTypesNoParticipationFields.message: No participation fields are defined for {appKey} in the platform model, and no extra fields are tagged with this app on the People module. For Helpdesk, add app-scoped custom fields in Modules & fields if needed.

peopleTypesUsingPlatformDefaults.message: Using platform defaults for this type.

peopleTypesPlatformDefaultNoFields.message: Platform default is no fields for this type.

peopleTypesDeleteInUse.message: This role is used by {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}. Removing it from the list does not change existing records; they will keep their current role value until updated.
peopleTypesDeleteInUse.description: Delete role confirm when in use

peopleTypesDeleteEmpty.message: Remove this role from the list?

peopleTypesErrDuplicateExists.message: A role with that name already exists.

peopleTypesErrDuplicateNames.message: Duplicate role names are not allowed.

peopleTypesErrEmptyName.message: Each role must have a non-empty name.

peopleTypesErrAtLeastOne.message: At least one role is required.

peopleTypesFieldsLoadConnection.message: Could not load People fields for this screen. Check your connection and permissions.

peopleTypesFieldsLoadFailed.message: Could not load People module fields.
